summary: Wearable Devices Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K on October 13, 2026, attaching a press release dated the same day announcing its exhibition at Augmented Enterprise Summit 2026 in Atlanta from October 13-15 and the availability of its Mudra Studio Evaluation Kit for enterprise smart-glasses developers. No transaction, securities offering, board recommendation, advisor, or financial terms appear. The filing is incorporated by reference into specified Form S-8 and F-3 registration statements. This is an ordinary product-marketing and conference-participation disclosure, not a special situation; no deal terms or risk-arb angle exist.
